material_defects_found_and_fixed: F-R2 — the private-peer resolver was integrated only as a one-shot resolve (unused supervisor, no refresh/invalidation on peer transition), violating §21/§22. Fixed with createPeerSupervisor wired into the attester composition; network.test.mjs F1-F4.

F-R1-final — regate() bound gatePassedForGeneration = generation.id ('whatever generation is current now') after its awaited gate+seed, so an invalidation crossing the re-gate could bind eligibility to the rotated generation using samples partly from the old one. Fixed: regate() snapshots startGen, runs a generation-bound gate (discards any sample crossing a rotation), rechecks after gate + seed, and binds the SNAPSHOT at a final synchronous recheck; construction gate made uniformly snapshot-bound. Covered by regate.test.mjs (27) + the static writer guard inventory.test.mjs (13).
